disclaimer: Fictional records for the ResolveNest demo. Not real product, customer or defect data.

records.title: PDF export truncates tables wider than the page
records.description: Reports with more than 12 columns lose the right-most columns when exported to PDF. The new layout engine does not wrap or scale wide tables.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to the PDF layout engine shipped in v2.1.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix merged in PR-3982 and listed in the v2.1.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Switch the PDF page orientation to landscape or hide unused columns before exporting.

records.title: Scheduled reports delivered twice on daylight-saving transitions
records.description: On the night a timezone switches to or from daylight-saving time, scheduled reports set to run at 01:00-03:00 local time are executed twice.
records.fix_evidence: Scheduler now stores run times in UTC. Listed in the v2.2.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Schedule reports outside the 01:00-03:00 local window.

records.title: Dashboard filters reset after browser back navigation
records.description: Applying dashboard filters, opening a widget drill-down and pressing the browser back button resets all filters to their defaults.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the filter panel redesign in v2.1.0.
records.fix_evidence: Filter state is now persisted in the URL. Listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Open drill-downs in a new tab.

records.title: SAML login loops when the IdP clock is ahead by more than 2 minutes
records.description: The SAML assertion validator applied zero tolerance to NotBefore, so users were redirected back to the IdP repeatedly when the IdP clock was slightly ahead.
records.fix_evidence: A 3-minute clock skew tolerance was added. Listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Synchronize the IdP server clock with NTP.

records.title: Data import rejects CSV files saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark
records.description: Files exported from spreadsheet tools with a UTF-8 BOM fail validation because the first header is read as '\ufeffaccount_id'.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Reporter states the problem started on the 2.2 line; the exact patch version was never recorded.
records.fix_evidence: BOM stripping added to the rewritten import pipeline. Listed in the v2.3.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Save the file as 'CSV (comma delimited)' without BOM.

records.title: Role editor allows saving a role with no permissions
records.description: Custom roles can be saved with an empty permission set. Users assigned to such a role can sign in but see a blank workspace.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Custom role editor first shipped in v2.2.0.
records.workaround: Product decision: empty roles are allowed for staged onboarding. Documented in KB-007.

records.title: Dashboard widgets show stale cached results for up to 15 minutes
records.description: Widget query cache is not invalidated when the underlying dataset refreshes, so figures can lag the source data by up to 15 minutes.
records.fix_evidence: Cache invalidation on dataset refresh. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.

records.title: Scheduled report emails omit attachments larger than 10 MB
records.description: When a scheduled report attachment exceeds 10 MB the email is sent without the attachment and without an error message.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Mail relay size limit introduced with the email provider change in v2.2.1.
records.workaround: Enable 'Send as download link' in the schedule settings.

records.title: API cursor pagination returns duplicate rows
records.description: Paginating /v2/transactions with a page size above 200 can return the last row of one page again as the first row of the next page.
records.fix_evidence: Cursor now encodes a tiebreaker column. Listed in the v2.3.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Use page sizes of 200 or less, or de-duplicate by transaction id.

records.title: PDF export renders non-Latin characters as empty boxes
records.description: Japanese, Thai and Arabic text is rendered as placeholder boxes in PDF exports because the fallback font set is missing.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Font bundle trimmed during the v2.3.0 build size reduction.
records.fix_evidence: Noto fallback fonts restored. Listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Export as XLSX and print from a spreadsheet tool.

records.title: Data import progress bar stuck at 99%
records.description: The import completes in the background but the progress bar never reaches 100% and the summary screen is not shown.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the import pipeline rewrite in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Completion event now emitted after the final batch. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Reload the import history page to see the completed import.

records.title: CSV export fails with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE when a report contains custom date fields
records.description: The streaming CSV serializer introduced in 2.3.0 throws on custom date fields that have a null value or a non-ISO display format. The export is aborted, the user sees 'Export failed (ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE)' and the downloaded file is 0 bytes. Scheduled reports that attach CSV files send an empty attachment. XLSX and PDF exports are not affected.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression bisected to the streaming CSV export engine shipped in v2.3.0 (PR-4471).
records.fix_evidence: Fix merged in PR-5120: null-safe date formatting in the CSV serializer. Shipped in v2.3.2 and listed in its release notes. Verified by QA on 2026-08-03.
records.workaround: Export the report as XLSX, or remove custom date columns from the report before exporting to CSV. See KB-012.

records.title: CSV export column order differs from the on-screen report layout
records.description: Columns that were reordered in the report viewer are exported in their original definition order.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Column reordering in the viewer was added in v2.1.0 without updating the exporter.
records.workaround: Reorder columns in the report definition instead of the viewer.

records.title: Token scope picker hides reports:write for organization admins
records.description: Organization admins creating a service token do not see the reports:write scope in the picker, although they are allowed to grant it.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Scope picker UI rebuilt in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Scope list now derived from the admin permission set. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Create the token through POST /v2/tokens with the scope listed explicitly.

records.title: Large CSV exports time out after 120 seconds
records.description: Exports above roughly 500,000 rows exceed the 120-second gateway timeout and fail with 'Export timed out'. Smaller exports of the same report succeed.
records.workaround: Split the export by date range, or use the asynchronous export API. See KB-014.

records.title: SSO users lose their role assignment after nightly SCIM sync
records.description: Users provisioned through SCIM whose IdP group name contains a slash are reassigned to the default Viewer role during the nightly sync.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Group name parser change in v2.3.1.
records.fix_evidence: Group names are now matched verbatim. Listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Rename IdP groups to avoid '/' characters.

records.title: Dashboards render blank in Safari 17
records.description: After the v2.4.0 rendering upgrade, dashboards load an empty canvas in Safari 17. Other browsers are not affected.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Started with the dashboard rendering upgrade in v2.4.0.
records.workaround: Use a Chromium-based browser or Firefox.

records.title: Expired API tokens return 403 Forbidden instead of 401 Unauthorized
records.description: Requests with an expired token receive 403 with error 'insufficient_scope' instead of 401 'token_expired', which misleads integrators into checking scopes.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Scoped token middleware introduced in v2.2.0.
records.workaround: Check the token expiry date in Settings > API Tokens before investigating scopes. See KB-015.

records.title: Webhook retry backoff ignores the receiver's Retry-After header
records.description: When a receiver responds 429 or 503 with Retry-After, the dispatcher still uses its own exponential schedule (1, 5, 15, 45 minutes). Found during code review; no customer impact has been confirmed.

records.title: Scheduled reports skip runs for timezones at UTC+13 or UTC+14
records.description: The v2.4.0 timezone engine computes the next run date one day late for UTC+13 and UTC+14 offsets, so daily runs are skipped every other day.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the scheduled report timezone engine in v2.4.0.
records.workaround: Set the schedule timezone to UTC and adjust the run hour.
